project.name: PoshanAI
project.tagline: AI-Powered Micronutrient Deficiency Diet Planner for Indian Context
project.type: Final Year B.Tech CSE Project + Project Seminar (CSP-018)
project.institution: JB Institute of Technology, Veer Madho Singh Bhandari Uttarakhand Technical University
project.goal: Build a production-ready, scalable, secure web app that detects micronutrient deficiencies from blood reports and generates personalized Indian meal plans using AI.
project.problem_statement: India me 50%+ women anemia se peedit hain, 70-90% Indians me Vitamin D deficiency hai, 47% urban population me B12 deficiency hai. Blood reports samajhna aam aadmi ke liye mushkil hai, generic diet apps Western food pe focus karte hain, aur Indian thali + medical conditions ignore karte hain.
project.solution: AI-powered web app jo user profile, blood report (OCR), diet, aur routine analyze karke micronutrient deficiencies detect karta hai aur IFCT 2017 (Indian Food Composition Table) + Gemini API (RAG) se personalized Indian meal plan banata hai. Blood test suggestion bhi deta hai with medical disclaimers.
core_innovation: LLM + RAG for personalized meal planning
Multi-input personalization (age, weight, height, condition, diet, routine)
Medical safety: AI never diagnoses, only awareness + suggestion with disclaimers

critical_current_error.title: BLOCKER — Backend cannot connect to MongoDB Atlas
critical_current_error.root_cause: Node.js v24.13.0+ has a confirmed DNS resolver bug (c-ares) on Windows. It fails to resolve both SRV records and A records for Atlas hostnames. Even legacy (non-SRV) connection strings fail with 'queryA ENOTFOUND'.
critical_current_error.why_compass_works: MongoDB Compass uses a different driver/library that does not use Node.js c-ares. It resolves fine.
symptoms: MongooseServerSelectionError: Could not connect to any servers
what_has_been_tried_and_failed: Switching to Legacy (non-SRV) connection string — FAILED (queryA ENOTFOUND)
Adding 0.0.0.0/0 to Atlas IP whitelist — DONE (Active) but not enough
Removing dns.setServers and using raw URI — FAILED
nslookup works at OS level — but Node.js internal resolver fails

steps: 1. Install nvm-windows from https://github.com/coreybutler/nvm-windows/releases (nvm-setup.exe, run as admin)
9. Expected: 'MongoDB Connected' + 'PoshanAI API listening on port 5000'
solution.why_works: Node.js v22 LTS does not have the c-ares DNS regression. It is stable and tested with MongoDB Atlas.

naming.files: camelCase for .js, PascalCase for React components

coding_conventions.error_handling: try/catch in async functions, next(err) in Express
coding_conventions.formatting: Prettier defaults (2 spaces, single quotes, semicolons)
coding_conventions.functions: Max 50 lines, single responsibility, arrow functions for callbacks

react.components: Functional components only, no class components
react.styling: Tailwind classes only, no inline styles, no CSS modules
react.animations: Prefer Motion Primitives; fallback to Framer Motion; GSAP only for complex scroll timelines
react.state: Redux Toolkit for global, useState for local

api_response_format.error: { success: false, error: { code: 'ERROR_CODE', message: 'Human readable' } }

security_rules.auth: JWT access token (15min) + refresh token (7d, httpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict cookie). Rotate refresh tokens.
security_rules.rbac: requireRole(['admin']) middleware on admin routes. Check ownership on every resource access.
security_rules.secrets: ALL secrets in .env. Never in code, never in Git. Use .env.example as template. Add .env to .gitignore.
security_rules.error_handling: Never expose stack traces to client. Log server-side, send generic message.
security_rules.rate_limiting: 100 req/15min general, 5 req/15min on auth routes.
ai_safety: Sanitize OCR text before sending to LLM (prompt injection)
Validate AI output against nutrient bounds
RAG grounding restricted to verified IFCT dataset only
Always include medical disclaimer in AI responses
frontend_security: Access token in memory only (NOT localStorage)
